import re
from wordcloud import WordCloud
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(text):
    """
    Generate and plot a word cloud after removing URLs.

    Parameters
    ----------
    text : str
        Input text.

    Returns
    -------
    WordCloud
        The generated word cloud object.

    Raises
    ------
    ValueError
        If no words remain after removing URLs.
    """
    if text is None:
        text = ""

    # Remove URLs
    cleaned_text = re.sub(r"https?://\S+|www\.\S+", " ", str(text))

    # Extract words after URL removal
    words = re.findall(r"\b[\w']+\b", cleaned_text)

    if not words:
        raise ValueError("No words available to generate a word cloud after removing URLs.")

    # Generate word cloud from remaining words
    wordcloud = WordCloud(width=800, height=400, background_color="white").generate(" ".join(words))

    # Plot the word cloud
    plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
    plt.imshow(wordcloud, interpolation="bilinear")
    plt.axis("off")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    return wordcloud
